title: DARPA man talking to a computer with his mind
summary: Grant Cameron tells of DARPA man talking to a computer with his mind, about c. 1974 at DARPA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He said, "I'm talking to this machine with my mind." [laughter]

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, passes on a story from a filmmaker, Bob Emenegger, set around 1974 at DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research. According to the story, a man there said, "I'm talking to this machine with my mind." If true, it would mean the military was working on linking minds and computers decades ago.
